shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#5 at its new head `cfe8a3c`. The merge still waits on the other reviewers: `experiment-repo`, `figtab-repo` and `idea-repo`.

- **Checks:** `hutian/delivery` and `hutian/document` both pass.
- **Length:** the built PDF is 21 pages on US Letter. The References heading is on page 9, so the main text is within the 9-page limit. The checklist is on page 15 and the appendix follows the references.
- **Template:** `venue/neurips_2026.sty`, `neurips_2026.tex` and `checklist.tex` are byte-identical to the official template.
- **Open note:** the non-blocking Type 3 font `F53` is still there.

I read the PDF from the `dev` build, because `pull-5/document.pdf` was still built from the older head `b5b17c0`. `dev` is built from the same commit as the candidate head.
